business_summary: Tianjin Motor Dies Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, production, and sale of automotive body panel molds and related products in China and internationally. The company offers automotive body panel molds and stamping parts, inspection tools, and welding fixtures; aviation parts; stamping parts and welding; electronic and communication equipment; and vehicle process equipment. It also provides technical consulting, computer application, import and export, and software development services. Tianjin Motor Dies Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Tianjin, China.
